description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between four different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—and an unlabeled metric across varying numbers of tokens. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 200. The y-axis lacks a label but utilizes a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Four solid lines with circular markers represent the data categories, with specific data points plotted at x-values of 200, 500, 800, and 1000. The blue line, representing "Tutorials," begins at a value of approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises steadily through 27 at 500 tokens to a peak of roughly 29 at 800 tokens, and ends slightly lower at approximately 28.5 at 1000 tokens. The red line, denoting "Library Documentation," starts at approximately 26 at 200 tokens, increases to 29 at 500 tokens and peaks at 32 at 800 tokens, before declining to roughly 27 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line, indicating "StackOverflow posts," exhibits a continuous decline across the x-axis, starting at a high of approximately 33 at 200 tokens, dropping to 30.5 at 500 tokens, 19 at 800 tokens, and concluding at approximately 11.5 at 1000 tokens. Finally, the green line, representing "Github files," begins at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, rises to 30.5 at 500 tokens, peaks at roughly 33 at 800 tokens, and decreases to approximately 30 at 1000 tokens.
